question: Find the final RS20 overlay. Read HCFG resource length u32le at +8 and scratch length u16le at +12; bytes +16..+47 are the scratch SHA-256, the HCFG resource starts at +48, and scratch follows it. Verify exact end bounds and scratch SHA-256. Locate the unique CRC32-valid HCFG record: bytes 0..3 are ASCII HCFG, byte 4 is version, byte 5 is the XOR key.
oracle_args: RS20 m hcfg_resource_length:8:u32le scratch_length:12:u16le scratch_sha256:16:32 hcfg_resource:48:hcfg_resource_length
note: truncated: declared resource runs past EOF
oracle_cmd: bash tests/data/binary_fixtures/layoutq_oracle.sh layoutq_decoy_truncated.bin "$(jq -r .oracle_args layoutq_decoy_truncated.json)"  (grep -obaF / od / dd|sha256sum / stat)
